The '''2010–11 [[Washington Huskies men's basketball]] team''' represented the [[University of Washington]] in the [[2010–11 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2010–11]] [[college basketball]] season.  This was head coach [[Lorenzo Romar]]'s 9th season at Washington. The Huskies played their home games at [[Alaska Airlines Arena at Hec Edmundson Pavilion|Alaska Airlines Arena]] and are members of the [[Pacific-10 Conference]]. As the winner of the [[2011 Pacific-10 Conference men's basketball tournament]], the Huskies earn an automatic bid in the [[2011 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], the school's 16th appearance in the NCAA tournament. At the national tournament, the Huskies beat [[2010–11 Georgia Bulldogs men's basketball team|Georgia]] in the second round before falling to eventual Elite Eight contender [[2010–11 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] in the third round. They finished the season with a 24–11 record.
